summary: Join our Storytelling with Data course tailored for senior executives. Learn to craft compelling narratives that drive strategic decisions and inspire action.
lede: Executive data storytelling turns metrics into a clear narrative that supports decisions, alignment, and accountability. Designed for senior leaders who communicate performance, strategy, or outcomes, this course covers how to start with a decision, tailor evidence to an audience, choose and simplify charts, and explain KPIs, uncertainty, and risk.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for leaders who must communicate insight, direction, and performance using data.
modules: Why Data Storytelling Is an Executive Skill
Start with the Decision, Not the Data
Audience and Context: What Executives Actually Need
Choosing the Right Chart for the Message
Persuasion, Ethics, and Avoiding Data Manipulation
Data Storytelling in Public Sector and NGOs
prerequisites: Participants should have experience in data interpretation and executive communications. Familiarity with basic data visualization tools is recommended.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
